display.title: Episode 258: The Tall Chanukah Candles (Chanukah)
display.summary_short: A Chanukah show with singer Eli Lipsker in Studio 604, the story of the Rebbe Rashab's three-foot Chanukah candles, and the words 'Asher Kiddeshanu' at mitzvah time.
display.summary_long: Broadcast during Chanukah 5747. Uncle Yossi opens with the message of the Chanukah lights, emunah and bitachon in the G-d of miracles, and the hope that next Chanukah the Kohen Gadol will light the menorah in the third Beis HaMikdash. Guest singer Eli Lipsker performs 'Oy Chanukah', 'I Have a Little Dreidel' and 'Sevivon'. Three young siblings lead the Shema. Story time tells of Naftali, a Chassid who danced every Chanukah in front of the Aron Kodesh. Before a journey, the Rebbe Rashab blessed him and told him to buy Chanukah candles three feet tall. Stranded by a blizzard on the first night, Naftali was seized by robbers; he lit the tall candles, and their flames were seen by firemen in a distant watchtower, whose approach scared the robbers away. At mitzvah time, a girl answers a phone quiz on 'Melech HaOlam' and wins a Shabbos candlestick, and Uncle Yossi teaches 'Asher Kiddeshanu', with the Alter Rebbe's explanation that 'asher' also means 'how fortunate'. The show ends with a sponsor message, contest news and a reminder to light Chanukah candles before Shabbos candles on Friday.
display.lesson: Following a tzaddik's instructions brings Hashem's protection, and we should be happy and thankful for the miracles Hashem does for us.

date.note: Candle lighting for 'this Friday, January the 2nd' (said as 1986; means 1987), when all eight Chanukah candles are lit before Shabbos; the Tuesday before is 30 Dec 1986, 4th night of Chanukah.
